layout.footerTagline: Home services with a calmer, cleaner experience.
layout.footerDescription: We keep the interface wide, quiet, and practical so the important details stay visible. Booking, browsing, and follow-up feel simple across every language.

home.heroDesc: Discover a wider, calmer booking experience with deeper service context, clearer choices, and stronger trust signals.
home.featuredDesc: A quick overview of the most requested jobs, with clear descriptions and local-language service names.
home.storyTitle: Built for people who want clarity before they book
home.storyDesc: The product is designed to feel wide, calm, and informative. Instead of squeezing content into narrow cards, we surface the details people usually look for first: speed, trust, and what happens next.
home.storyPoint1Desc: The layouts now surface stronger context up front, so users can choose faster.
home.storyPoint2Desc: The booking flow is intentionally lightweight, with fewer visual distractions.
home.promise1: Clear communication from enquiry to completion, with no confusing handoffs.
home.promise2: Verified professionals matched to the job instead of a one-size-fits-all approach.
home.promise3: A modern interface that keeps the important details easy to scan on desktop and mobile.
home.testimonialsTitle: What people say after the first booking

testimonials.oneQuote: The site finally feels easy to read. I could understand the service before I booked it.
testimonials.twoQuote: The wider layout makes it feel premium and less cluttered than the old version.
testimonials.threeQuote: Switching languages worked across the whole page, not just the menu.

home.processTitle: A simple flow from search to service
home.processDesc: The site now gives people enough context to move forward without adding clutter.

servicesPage.heroDesc: A wider service catalog with filters, local-language labels, and enough context to compare before you book.
servicesPage.searchHint: Search by the job you need, the room, or the problem you want solved.
servicesPage.value1Desc: Each listing focuses on clarity, so users know what they are booking.
servicesPage.value2Desc: The layout helps people compare options and move quickly.
servicesPage.value3Desc: The cards are larger, cleaner, and easier to scan on wide screens.

servicesPage.step1Desc: Use the filters or search to narrow the service list quickly.
servicesPage.step2Desc: Check the service summary, support signals, and what is included.
servicesPage.step3Desc: Submit the form and our team will respond with the next step.
servicesPage.faq1Q: How quickly will someone contact me?
servicesPage.faq1A: Usually within the same day, and often much sooner for urgent requests.
servicesPage.faq2Q: Can I switch the language while browsing?
servicesPage.faq2A: Yes. The full interface and content sections update together.
servicesPage.faq3Q: Do I need to know the exact service name?
servicesPage.faq3A: No. Search by the issue or room and the catalog will guide you.

aboutPage.storyTitle: A more thoughtful way to book home services
aboutPage.storyDesc: GreenShield is moving toward a quieter, clearer service platform with more visible context and fewer dead spaces. The goal is to help families act confidently without wading through noisy screens.
aboutPage.localDesc: We focus on the rhythm of real homes, real neighborhoods, and real timing needs.
aboutPage.careDesc: Spacing, contrast, and language support all matter when people are trying to make a decision quickly.
aboutPage.pillar1Desc: We want every screen to feel reliable, not rushed.
aboutPage.pillar2Desc: Wide layouts and clean hierarchy make decisions easier.
aboutPage.pillar3Desc: Helpful communication matters as much as the service itself.
aboutPage.pillar4Desc: Shorter paths from browsing to contact improve conversion.
aboutPage.milestone1: Started with a simple idea: make home service booking feel less messy.
aboutPage.milestone2: Expanded into a broader catalog with more clarity for each service.
aboutPage.milestone3: Now evolving into a multilingual platform with a modern visual system.
